init_anghabench_dataset: create an AnghaBenchDataset instance with a site data base path and optional manifest URL
benchmark_from_parsed_uri: resolve a BenchmarkUri to a Benchmark by compiling C source to LLVM bitcode on demand
compile_all_benchmarks: compile all benchmarks in the AnghaBench dataset in parallel using a thread pool executor
install_anghabench: install the AnghaBench dataset by downloading the tar archive and manifest from GitHub and FBAI
review_anghabench_dataset_class: review the AnghaBenchDataset class that extends TarDatasetWithManifest for lazy C to LLVM-IR compilation
